scope: Retail CPU/RAM/FPU/MMIO comparison of aligned synchronous root-to-G2 word copy and native arm/wait/release helpers. Independent data, preserved source/tail and callback payload checks. Real frame services, native object dispatcher and pending count getter execute with one or two pending objects and queue index wrap. Object user callback is inactive or retail no-op. Frame/transfer contexts and bus states remain synthetic. Unaligned paths, busy delays and physical hardware not covered.
